title: a full brief skips the interview
prompt: /make-design-system for Fieldnote: calm, outdoorsy, trustworthy. Light mode only.

judge.q: Before showing candidate design systems, did the assistant ask the user any question about the brief (purpose, audience, feel, light/dark, constraints)?
Did the assistant present exactly three candidate design systems?
Is any candidate described as dark-only or dark-first presented WITHOUT saying it would need inverting or a light mode built for this light-only brief?
